Most lifters who are trying to build or keep muscle land somewhere around 0.7 to 1 gram of protein per pound of bodyweight a day, which is roughly 1.6 to 2.2 grams per kilo. Spreading it over three or four meals works better than loading it all into one, and eating more than that range mostly just adds calories rather than extra muscle.

That is general context, not a target for you. If you want the app to work out your own numbers, I can set that up, and a dietitian is the right call if you have a medical condition or special dietary needs.
